name: timona-starter
description: Modern Fullstack Starter Kit with Next.js + NestJS + GraphQL + Prisma + Redis + TailwindCSS v4 - Timona Domain

scripts.dev:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cp .env.timona frontend/.env.local && concurrently "bun run dev:timona:backend" "bun run dev:timona:frontend"
scripts.dev:timona:backend: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && PORT=15001 bun run dev
scripts.dev:timona:frontend: cp .env.timona frontend/.env.local && cd frontend && bun run dev -- -p 15000
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend
scripts.lint: bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:frontend
scripts.setup: bun install && cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules bun.lockb backend/bun.lockb frontend/bun.lockb
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:pushforce: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:push:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:studio:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma studio
scripts.db:seed:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:backup:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && bun run prisma/backup.ts
scripts.db:restore:timona: cp .env.timona backend/.env && cd backend && bun run prisma/restore.ts

author: Timona Team
